instruction: A chunky hot-rod car built entirely from interlocking plastic bricks, with studded flame decals, oversized rear slick tires, and an exposed brick engine block poking through the hood. Glossy red and black pieces snap together in visible stud rows, and clip-on chrome exhaust bricks flank the sides.
